b.label: H.R. 8197 (119th Congress) - bill to abolish AARO

edges.label: recommended AARO's complete defunding to the DOGE subcommittee in March 2026, weeks before the bill
edges.note: Luna's defunding recommendation and Burchett's abolition bill are the same judgement expressed through appropriations and authorisation respectively.

edges.label: 1 April 2026 letter demanding AARO's UAP video holdings
edges.note: Luna wrote to the Secretary of War for video files held by AARO after September 2025 witnesses told the Task Force AARO held additional records; the PURSUE releases followed within five weeks.

edges.label: successor whose reported apology to Congress concerns his predecessor's conduct
edges.note: If Luna's account is accurate, a sitting AARO director conceded to members of Congress that the office's founding leadership behaved improperly toward Congress and witnesses - the nearest thing to an institutional admission in the record.
